name: Alarms and reminders
plain: Lets the app fire alarms at an exact time.
meaning: Wakes the phone at precise times. Revoking it cancels all future exact alarms and stops the app.

android.persistence: Until revoked; not pre-granted for new installs targeting 13+ on Android 14 (API 34)
android.revocation: Settings > Special app access > Alarms and reminders
android.store_policy: Play: restricted; only for alarm, calendar, or timer-like core use
android.note: ACTION_SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM_PERMISSION_STATE_CHANGED fires on grant. Inexact alarms are delivered within 1 hour on API 31+ with a minimum window of 10 minutes.

ios.note: Local notifications fire at set times without extra permission beyond notifications; iOS 26 adds AlarmKit for alarm-style apps.

limits.headline: Can set alarms at an exact time on Android, if you allow Alarms and reminders
limits.user_action: You turn on the Alarms and reminders switch in Settings, or set an alarm in the app
can: Fire an alarm or reminder at an exact minute
Work again after you allow it, since Android tells the app about the change
Fire local notifications on iPhone at set times
cannot: Use exact alarms on Android 12 or newer without your toggle, unless it is an alarm or calendar app
Make normal alarms exact; they can arrive within about an hour
Use iPhone alarm style alerts before iOS 26, when AlarmKit arrived
limits.differs: Android 12 and newer needs a settings toggle. iPhone uses local notifications, with AlarmKit added in iOS 26.

story.what_it_is: Lets an Android app fire alarms and reminders at an exact time.

marketing.name: Schedule exact alarms
marketing.pitch: Google describes exact alarms for apps where the precise time is core to the feature, like alarms and calendars.

story.for_you: Your reminder goes off at exactly 7:30. You can switch this off in Alarms and reminders, and then the app can no longer do exact times.
story.for_makers: Makers need exact timing for calendars, alarms and pill reminders. Google limits it because exact alarms wake the phone and cost battery.

use_cases.example: A calendar rings your meeting reminder at the exact minute.
A medication app rings at 8:00 sharp to take your pill.
An interval timer beeps on the second for your workout.
A game rings when a timed crop is ready.
A flight app alerts you 3 hours before takeoff on the dot.
A language app reminds you to practice at your chosen time.
A cooking timer rings at the exact end time.

story.android_note: Settings toggle called Alarms and reminders. Inexact alarms can be late by up to an hour.
story.ios_note: Local notifications fire at set times. iOS 26 adds AlarmKit for alarm style apps.

technical_bounds: iOS code cannot run at an exact time

history.change: Denied by default for fresh installs targeting 13+; kept on upgrade
SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM denied by default for apps targeting 13+
USE_EXACT_ALARM added for alarm and calendar apps
